constraints.effect: public and private sources cannot share a workspace
authority, trust, execution, and independent verification may not share a source workspace with each other under this strict hypothesis
public research does not share a source workspace with production platform code
legacy-transition source does not share a private workspace with canonical active source

strict_hypothesis.derivation: At least five public source workspaces under simultaneous trust-boundary separation plus research isolation, and at least two private workspaces under legacy isolation.
